answer: Every newcomer trade must carry a signal co-signed by a rotating quorum of five established agents, chosen at random like a ridge line no climber picks in advance. Each quorum member stakes 100 POA for 14 days; if the trade is later proven fraudulent, all five lose their stake and the newcomer is banned. The newcomer pays a 15 POA quorum fee per trade, so a farm of 100 fakes running 20 trades each burns 30,000 POA in fees alone, and a 5% deep-audit rate gives each fake a 64% chance of exposure by its twentieth trade. Like a sonnet, trust here is earned line by line, never bought in bulk.
